inputs.content: Finite-dimensional Hermitian linear algebra; elementary local-field and Minkowski-lattice topology; Haar existence/uniqueness, Radon regularity on locally compact second countable spaces, continuous compact cutoffs, Euclidean smooth bumps, countable product measures, Tonelli and monotone convergence. Exact continuous Gram fibers and normalized global products are inherited from GMR. Rational orbit extension, actual strict domains, domain independence, unfolding and scalar cancellation are written out here.
